A systematic meta-analysis of genetic, regional, and production determinants of global pork quality

Code and model outputs - Cook Loss

1 Loading packages and data

## load the packages
library(metafor)
library(orchaRd)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)
library(knitr)
library(openxlsx)
library(MuMIn)
library(glue)
library(rlang)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
## Load the functions from the script file
source("functions.R")
## Load the data for Cook Loss
data_CL <- read.csv("CL.csv")

## Convert columns to appropriate numeric types
data_CL$Mean <- as.numeric(data_CL$Mean)
data_CL$SD <- as.numeric(data_CL$SD)
data_CL$Sample <- as.numeric(data_CL$Sample)
data_CL$Age <- as.numeric(data_CL$Age)
data_CL$Weight <- as.numeric(data_CL$Weight)
data_CL$Digestible_energy <- as.numeric(data_CL$Digestible_energy)
data_CL$Crude_protein <- as.numeric(data_CL$Crude_protein)
data_CL$Crude_fat <- as.numeric(data_CL$Crude_fat)
data_CL$Crude_fiber <- as.numeric(data_CL$Crude_fiber)
data_CL$Ash <- as.numeric(data_CL$Ash)
data_CL$Lys <- as.numeric(data_CL$Lys)
data_CL$Met_and_Cys <- as.numeric(data_CL$Met_and_Cys)
data_CL$Thr <- as.numeric(data_CL$Thr)
data_CL$Try <- as.numeric(data_CL$Try)
data_CL$Val <- as.numeric(data_CL$Val)
data_CL$Dry_matter <- as.numeric(data_CL$Dry_matter)
data_CL$Ca <- as.numeric(data_CL$Ca)
data_CL$P <- as.numeric(data_CL$P)
data_CL$Na <- as.numeric(data_CL$Na)

## Convert columns to factor types
data_CL$Position <- factor(data_CL$Position)
data_CL$Breed <- factor(data_CL$Breed)
data_CL$Class <- factor(data_CL$Class)
data_CL$Sex <- factor(data_CL$Sex)
data_CL$Region <- factor(data_CL$Region)
data_CL$Aim <- factor(data_CL$Aim)
data_CL$Multiple_breeds <- factor(data_CL$Multiple_breeds)

## Calculate variance (rVar)
# rVar is the square of the standard error (SD/sqrt(Sample))
data_CL$rVar <- (data_CL$SD/sqrt(data_CL$Sample))^2

2 Testing random effects

## Run VCV matrix for all data
VCV_CL_AllData <- make_VCV_matrix(data_CL, 
                                   V = "rVar", 
                                   cluster = "StudyID", 
                                   obs = "RowID")

## Null model with VCV matrix:
# This model includes random effects for RowID (observation-level) and StudyID.
null_CL_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_CL_AllData, 
                       random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                     ~1 |StudyID),
                       sparse = TRUE,
                       data = data_CL, method = "ML")
summary(null_CL_mod) # AIC: 2531.7693            
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 413; method: ML)
## 
##     logLik    Deviance         AIC         BIC        AICc   
## -1262.8847   2138.2483   2531.7693   2543.8397   2531.8280   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##              estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed   factor 
## sigma^2.1   3.6916  1.9214    413     no    RowID 
## sigma^2.2  63.1148  7.9445    237     no  StudyID 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 412) = 7558834.4952, p-val < .0001
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se     zval    pval    ci.lb    ci.ub      
##  29.3372  0.5326  55.0873  <.0001  28.2934  30.3810  *** 
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## Test whether Region should be a random effect:
# Adds Region as a random effect to the null model structure.
Re_CL_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_CL_AllData, 
                       random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                     ~1 |StudyID,
                                     ~1 |Region),
                       sparse = TRUE,
                       data = data_CL, method = "ML")
summary(Re_CL_mod) #2471.9285

## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 413; method: ML)

##

## sigma^2.2  38.3436  6.1922    237     no  StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  25.3868  5.0385     50     no   Region 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 412) = 7558834.4952, p-val < .0001

## Full model with fixed effects for Position, Breed, Region, and Class
CL_full_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_CL_AllData, 
                      mods = ~Position + Breed + Region + Class,
                      random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                    ~1 |StudyID),
                      sparse = TRUE,
                      data = data_CL, method = "ML")
R2_Full <- round(r2_ml(CL_full_mod)*100, 2)
anova(CL_full_mod,null_CL_mod)
## 
##          df       AIC       BIC      AICc     logLik      LRT   pval           QE 
## Full    154 2493.4560 3113.0670 2678.4948 -1092.7280                   35103.1061 
## Reduced   3 2531.7693 2543.8397 2531.8280 -1262.8847 340.3133 <.0001 7558834.4952
## Model with Position as a fixed effect
CL_Position_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_CL_AllData, 
                          mods = ~Position,
                          random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                        ~1 |StudyID),
                          sparse = TRUE,
                          data = data_CL, method = "ML")
R2_Position <-round(r2_ml(CL_Position_mod)*100, 2)
anova(CL_Position_mod,null_CL_mod)
## 
##         df       AIC       BIC      AICc     logLik    LRT   pval           QE 
## Full    12 2544.9000 2593.1813 2545.6800 -1260.4500               7089419.8743 
## Reduced  3 2531.7693 2543.8397 2531.8280 -1262.8847 4.8694 0.8455 7558834.4952
## Model with Breed as a fixed effect
CL_Breed_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_CL_AllData,

R2_Breed <- round(r2_ml(CL_Breed_mod)*100, 2)
anova(CL_Breed_mod,null_CL_mod)

CL_Region_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_CL_AllData,

R2_Region <- round(r2_ml(CL_Region_mod)*100, 2)
anova(CL_Region_mod,null_CL_mod)

## Model with Class as a fixed effect
CL_Class_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_CL_AllData,

R2_Class <- round(r2_ml(CL_Class_mod)*100, 2)
anova(CL_Class_mod,null_CL_mod)
## 
##         df       AIC       BIC      AICc     logLik     LRT   pval           QE 
## Full    20 2549.0351 2629.5041 2551.1780 -1254.5176                7340563.3810 
## Reduced  3 2531.7693 2543.8397 2531.8280 -1262.8847 16.7342 0.4725 7558834.4952
## Create a table of R-squared values for models with moderators
R2_models_summary <- data.frame("Model" = c("Full",
                                     "Position",
                                     "Breed",
                                     "Region",
                                     "Class"),
                         "R2" = c(R2_Full[1],
                                  R2_Position[1],
                                  R2_Breed[1],
                                  R2_Region[1],
                                  R2_Class[1]))
R2_models_summary <- R2_models_summary %>% 
  transmute(Model = Model
            ,R2= round(R2,2))

colnames(R2_models_summary)[2] <- "$R^2(\\%)$"

R2_models_summary %>% 
  kable(format="html", escape=F, caption="Heterogeneity explained in the models with moderators") %>% 
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top") %>% 
  kable_styling(c("hover", "condensed"), full_width = F)

## Refit with REML for reporting in Manuscript
REML_CL_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_CL_AllData, 
                        random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                      ~1 |StudyID,
                                      ~1 |Region,
                                      # ~1 | Position, # Position was not better than null in initial test
                                      ~1 |Breed), 
                        sparse = TRUE,
                        data = data_CL, method = "REML")
summary(REML_CL_mod)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 413; method: REML)
## 
##     logLik    Deviance         AIC         BIC        AICc   
## -1227.3712   2454.7423   2464.7423   2484.8475   2464.8901   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##              estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed   factor 
## sigma^2.1   3.3254  1.8236    413     no    RowID 
## sigma^2.2  37.9979  6.1642    237     no  StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  26.5233  5.1501     50     no   Region 
## sigma^2.4   0.5601  0.7484    101     no    Breed 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 412) = 7558834.4952, p-val < .0001
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se     zval    pval    ci.lb    ci.ub      
##  29.0090  0.9597  30.2274  <.0001  27.1281  30.8900  *** 
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
# Calculate I-squared values
round(i2_ml(REML_CL_mod), 2)
##   I2_Total   I2_RowID I2_StudyID  I2_Region   I2_Breed 
##     100.00       4.86      55.55      38.77       0.82
# Calculate R-squared
round(r2_ml(REML_CL_mod)*100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##           0.00          95.14
## Generate orchard plot for the REML model
p_REML_CL <- orchard_plot(REML_CL_mod,
                               group = "StudyID",  
                               xlab = "Mean Cook Loss (%)",
                               cb = FALSE,
                               angle = 0,
                               legend.pos = "bottom.out",
                               branch.size = 1.5)

print(p_REML_CL)

3 Meta-regression

3.1 Breed

## Filter data for breeds with at least 3 distinct StudyIDs
data_CL_B3 <- data_CL %>%
  group_by(Breed) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(StudyID) >= 3) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()

## Create VCV matrix for the filtered breed data
VCV_CL_B3_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_CL_B3, 
                                   V = "rVar", 
                                   cluster = "StudyID", 
                                   obs = "RowID")
## Define random structure
random_structure_breed <- list(~1 |RowID,
                               ~1 |StudyID,
                               ~1 |Region)

# Model with intercept
Br_VCV_REML_CL_mod_int <- rma.mv(
  yi = Mean,
  V = VCV_CL_B3_Data,
  mods = ~ Breed,
  random = random_structure_breed,
  test = "t",
  method = "REML",
  data = data_CL_B3)
summary(Br_VCV_REML_CL_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 277; method: REML)
## 
##    logLik   Deviance        AIC        BIC       AICc   
## -782.0322  1564.0645  1600.0645  1664.2947  1602.8793   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##              estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed   factor 
## sigma^2.1   2.2087  1.4862    277     no    RowID 
## sigma^2.2  35.7055  5.9754    189     no  StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  26.4305  5.1411     44     no   Region 
## 
## Test for Residual Heterogeneity:
## QE(df = 262) = 1246807.4549, p-val < .0001
## 
## Test of Moderators (coefficients 2:15):
## F(df1 = 14, df2 = 262) = 1.5577, p-val = 0.0913

## Model Results:

round(r2_ml(Br_VCV_REML_CL_mod_int)*100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##           4.83          96.73
# Model without intercept for plotting
Br_VCV_REML_CL_mod <- rma.mv(
  yi = Mean,
  V = VCV_CL_B3_Data,
  mods = ~ Breed -1,
  random = random_structure_breed,
  test = "t",
  method = "REML",
  data = data_CL_B3)
## Orchard plot for Breed moderator
p_Br_VCV_REML_CL <- orchard_plot(Br_VCV_REML_CL_mod, 
                                  mod = "Breed",  
                                  group = "StudyID",  
                                  xlab = "Mean Cook Loss (%)",
                                  cb = FALSE,
                                  angle = 0,
                                  legend.pos = "bottom.out",
                                  branch.size = 1.5)
print(p_Br_VCV_REML_CL)

## Generate table of pairwise comparisons for Breed using all_models function
res_CL_Br <- all_models(
  data        = data_CL_B3,
  vcv         = VCV_CL_B3_Data,
  yi_col      = "Mean",
  mod_name    = "Breed",
  random_list = random_structure_breed 
)

3.6 Age

## Filter data for complete cases of Age
data_CL_Age <- data_CL[complete.cases(data_CL$Age), ]

## Create VCV matrix for Age data
VCV_CL_Age_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_CL_Age, 
                                    V = "rVar", 
                                    cluster = "StudyID", 
                                    obs = "RowID")
## Define common random structure for continuous moderators
random_structure_continuous <- list(~1 |RowID,
                                    ~1 |StudyID,
                                    ~1 |Region,  
                                    ~1 |Breed)

## Run meta-regression for Age
res_CL_Age <- run_meta_ct(
  dat         = data_CL_Age,          
  mod_var     = "Age",
  random_list = random_structure_continuous, 
  plot_name   = "p_CL_Age",              
  x_lab       = "Age (Days)",
  y_lab       = "Cook Loss (%)" # Updated label
)

## Generate summary table for Age models
mods_list_age <- attr(res_CL_Age$best_model, "mods_list") 
aic_tab_age   <- res_CL_Age$aic_table                   

tbl_CL_Age <- model_summary_tbl(
  mods_list_age, aic_tab_age, 
  lin_coef  = "mod_c",              
  quad_coef = "mod_c2"
)
## Display summary table for Age models
html_table_age <- tbl_CL_Age %>% 
  kable(format = "html", digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE, position = "left") %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "400px")  
print(html_table_age)

4 Publication bias and sensitivity analyses

4.1 Decline effect (Publication Year)

## Define random structure
random_structure_Ye <- list(~1 |RowID,
                            ~1 |StudyID,
                            ~1 |Region,  
                            ~1 |Breed) 

## Model with Publication Year (Years) as moderator
Ye_VCV_REML_CL_mod_int <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_CL_AllData, 
   mods = ~ Years,
   random = random_structure_Ye, 
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_CL)
summary(Ye_VCV_REML_CL_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 413; method: REML)
## 
##     logLik    Deviance         AIC         BIC        AICc   
## -1222.7315   2445.4630   2457.4630   2481.5746   2457.6709   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##              estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed   factor 
## sigma^2.1   3.3127  1.8201    413     no    RowID 
## sigma^2.2  37.8815  6.1548    237     no  StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  25.4381  5.0436     50     no   Region 
## sigma^2.4   0.5788  0.7608    101     no    Breed 
## 
## Test for Residual Heterogeneity:
## QE(df = 411) = 4827776.3559, p-val < .0001
## 
## Test of Moderators (coefficient 2):
## F(df1 = 1, df2 = 411) = 3.0311, p-val = 0.0824
## 
## Model Results:
## 
##           estimate        se     tval   df    pval       ci.lb     ci.ub    
## intrcpt  -526.8735  319.2820  -1.6502  411  0.0997  -1154.5030  100.7559  . 
## Years       0.2753    0.1581   1.7410  411  0.0824     -0.0355    0.5861  . 
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
round(r2_ml(Ye_VCV_REML_CL_mod_int)*100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##           0.91          95.12
## Bubble plot for decline effect
p_Ye_VCV_REML_CL <- orchaRd::bubble_plot(Ye_VCV_REML_CL_mod_int, 
                                  mod = "Years",
                                  group = "StudyID",
                                  xlab = "Publication year",
                                  ylab = "Mean Cook Loss (%)",
                                  g = TRUE)
p_Ye_VCV_REML_CL <- p_Ye_VCV_REML_CL + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2014, 2024, by = 2))
print(p_Ye_VCV_REML_CL)

4.2 Aim (Whether the aim of study was meat quality)

## Define random structure
random_structure_aim <- list(~1 |RowID,
                             ~1 |StudyID,
                             ~1 |Region,  
                             ~1 |Breed)

#Model with intercept
Ai_VCV_REML_CL_mod_int <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_CL_AllData, 
   mods = ~ Aim,
   random = random_structure_aim, 
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_CL)
summary(Ai_VCV_REML_CL_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 413; method: REML)
## 
##     logLik    Deviance         AIC         BIC        AICc   
## -1223.9978   2447.9956   2459.9956   2484.1072   2460.2035   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##              estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed   factor 
## sigma^2.1   3.3271  1.8240    413     no    RowID 
## sigma^2.2  38.0804  6.1709    237     no  StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  26.5578  5.1534     50     no   Region 
## sigma^2.4   0.5553  0.7452    101     no    Breed 
## 
## Test for Residual Heterogeneity:
## QE(df = 411) = 4886741.2106, p-val < .0001
## 
## Test of Moderators (coefficient 2):
## F(df1 = 1, df2 = 411) = 0.4993, p-val = 0.4802
## 
## Model Results:
## 
##          estimate      se     tval   df    pval    ci.lb    ci.ub      
## intrcpt   28.4773  1.2211  23.3209  411  <.0001  26.0769  30.8777  *** 
## AimYes     0.7550  1.0685   0.7066  411  0.4802  -1.3454   2.8555      
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
round(r2_ml(Ai_VCV_REML_CL_mod_int)*100, 2)

##           0.15          95.15
#Model without intercept for plotting
Ai_VCV_REML_CL_mod <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,

                                   xlab = "Mean Cook Loss (%)",
                                   cb = FALSE,
                                   angle = 0,
                                   legend.pos = "bottom.out",
                                   branch.size = 1.5)
print(p_Mu_VCV_REML_CL)
